name: Alex Morgan
headline: Senior IT Support Engineer
summary: Senior support engineer with eight years across managed Windows estates, Microsoft 365 and endpoint security. Known for turning recurring tickets into documented self-service guides.

bullets: Own second-line support for 1,200 users across 14 sites, closing 94% of tickets within SLA.
Rebuilt the onboarding runbook, cutting first-day setup from 90 to 35 minutes.
Introduced Intune compliance policies that removed 70% of manual patching checks.
Supported clinical staff across three hospitals on a 24/7 rota.
Wrote 40 knowledge-base articles adopted by the wider service desk.

projects.name: Self-service password reset
projects.summary: Rolled out SSPR with MFA for 1,200 users.
bullets: Password tickets fell by 62% in the first quarter after launch.
